label: zahirik
name: Zahirik
scene: You are working your stall in the village marketplace when a customer approaches and starts talking.
greeting: You carry the dust of long roads, traveler. Sit, rest your feet, and let Ol' Zahirik show you things unseen in any high-born city!
dismissal: May the sands protect you, stubborn friend! Go, compare my prices to the fools in the square. You will return!
